out_items.name: Person in charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties

violations.title: Ceasing Operations & Reporting (Voluntary for Imminent Health Hazard)
violations.observation: The permit holder failed to discontinue operations and notify the Health Department that an imminent health hazard may exist because of an emergency. OBSERVED THAT WATER AND GREASE WERE LEAKING FROM THE GREASE TRAP ONTO THE KITCHEN FLOOR.
violations.corrective_action: Facility closed while dealing with the stage backup. PIC had employee clean out the grease trap, and the sewage backup was corrected while EHS was still onsite. Facility reopened. LA TARATENITA (Inspection Date: 06/04/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink in the front service area being used to store silverware.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC HAD EMPLOYEES REMIVE SILVERWARE.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at the handwashing sink in the front service area.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC REPLACED PAPER TOWELS.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: observed raw beef stored over cooked beef and vegetables in the walk in cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC HAD EMPLOYEES BEGIN REARRANGING THE REFRIGERATOR.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 70F, No More than 2 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours: cooked potato on the counter 73F after 2.5 hrs and chicharron on the counter at 83F after 5 hours.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED FOOD.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours: beef in the walk in cooler cooked 6.5 hrs ago at 73F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. PIC DISCARDED BEEF.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device:beef 117F and potatoes 107F in the HH cabinet.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. PIC DISCARDED FOOD AND TURNED UP THE HH CABINET TEMPERATURE.

violations.title: Eggs Stored at 45F or less
violations.observation: Observed an ambient air temperature above 45F in the following refrigeration unit holding raw shells eggs: observed raw shell eggs stored at ambient 87F
violations.corrective_action: Shell eggs that have not been treated to destroy Salmonella shall be stored in refrigerated equipment that maintains an ambient temperature of 45F or less. PIC DISCARDED EGGS.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: rice 67F in the walk in cooler
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED RICE.
